idea-plugin.name: Merkzeug
idea-plugin.description:
Merkzeug is a visual Markdown editor for IntelliJ IDEA, with formatting tools, Mermaid diagrams, frontmatter, PDF export and printing. Your notes stay ordinary Markdown files in your project.

Visual editing alongside your Markdown source editor

Merkzeug adds a separate editor tab for the same Markdown file. Keep the built-in Markdown editor for source editing and switch to Merkzeug for visual editing. Both work with the same IntelliJ document. The JetBrains Markdown plugin is optional and is not replaced.

Other Markdown plugins can remain installed; compatibility depends on their editor registration. Compatibility with every third-party Markdown plugin is not guaranteed.

Images stay with their notes — including IntelliJ refactoring

Images inserted or pasted into Plan.md are saved as separate files in the sibling folder Plan.assets/, referenced by relative paths in the Markdown. The note and its companion folder can be versioned and shared together.

Merkzeug extends IntelliJ's own Refactor → Move and Refactor → Rename actions with this pairing rule. Renaming Plan.md to Draft.md also renames Plan.assets/ to Draft.assets/ and updates companion-folder references in the note. Moving a note includes its companion folder. Native Undo/Redo applies to both.

Existing destinations stop the operation; companion folders are not merged or overwritten. Existing shared assets/ folders remain supported and are not treated as belonging to one note. This rule applies to IntelliJ Move/Rename refactoring, not external filesystem actions, copying or deletion. Symbolic-link companions require manual handling.

Rename/Move also updates local Markdown links in other project notes, with or without a companion folder. Moving a note recalculates outgoing relative links. Inline links, images and reference-style definitions are supported, independently of the optional Markdown editor plugin; code examples and external URLs remain unchanged. Changes participate in native Undo/Redo.

Fits your IDE workflow

  • IntelliJ owns document saving, version control and undo history.
  • File → Print opens a printable PDF preview for the active Merkzeug editor.
  • Appearance follows the IDE theme, with optional PDF content styles while editing.
  • Portable vault templates and central PDF templates, including automatic discovery of desktop Merkzeug templates.
  • Copyable template styling prompts with an offline technical reference for coding agents.
  • Optional attachment guidance for coding agents: preview existing AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md contents and explicitly select which files receive the guidance.

Available as an additional editor tab for local .md files. The JetBrains Markdown plugin is optional.

Proprietary software, free for private and internal business use under the Merkzeug End User License Agreement.

For IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.2 and later 2026.2.x releases (builds 262.10315.125–262.*), with JCEF enabled.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.2 — portable templates and release history.

  • Choose a central PDF template or a template inside your vault from the PDF controls in every edition. Vault-relative template settings travel with your repository.
  • Read the complete release history in the app. New versions show their release notes automatically on first launch.
